# Doocs default example

`example.md` is the unchanged Chinese default Markdown from [doocs/md](https://github.com/doocs/md/blob/a7c17fc4cda92e3c13aa7e24f06615cfa4219b31/apps/web/src/assets/example/markdown.zh-CN.md), commit `a7c17fc4cda92e3c13aa7e24f06615cfa4219b31`, retrieved 2026-10-05.

SHA-256: `455a0c3ace000f57c94454dc2c23a47c1b135b2da0e71bcf7a21069b36dab2bd`.

The live https://md.doocs.org/ preview showed the same 6,688-character example.
CI supplies local image responses for the two external images, preserving the source.
These files are test references and are not bundled into the application.
